subject.title: feat(ui): show waiting-for-approval run status in chat

question: Does the current exact run-ID correlation contract provide sufficient ownership proof for this Control UI status, including the intended reconnect/remount behavior, or should authoritative hydration be added at the gateway boundary first?
rationale: The PR deliberately avoids session-level inference to prevent false labels, but whether the existing lifecycle and overlay snapshot contract is the permanent owner boundary is a product and protocol decision that automated review cannot safely settle.

options.title: Accept current UI boundary
options.body: Keep exact run-ID matching in the Control UI, after adding live proof that normal parked runs hydrate and unrelated approvals do not label foreground work.

options.title: Add authoritative gateway hydration
options.body: Extend the gateway contract with explicit active-run ownership state before merging a UI hydration path that depends on locally learned run IDs.

recommendation.title: Accept current UI boundary
recommendation.body: Keep exact run-ID matching in the Control UI, after adding live proof that normal parked runs hydrate and unrelated approvals do not label foreground work.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked merged approval lifecycle and approval UI work show direct ownership of the producer and consumer boundary.
